question: What destructive power is attributed to the practitioner when angered?
premises: The practitioner is described as angry
The practitioner has the power to destroy
The object of destruction is the entire triple world with moving and unmoving beings
inference: When angered, the practitioner can destroy the entire triple world, both moving and unmoving
plain_english: But when angry, he can destroy the entire triple world, with all that moves and does not move.
